jobs.name: Idle_Candidate
jobs.prompt: A healthy confident young adult stands upright in a relaxed neutral stance, spine tall, pelvis neutral, shoulders open and level, head looking straight ahead. Both hands rest loosely closed beside the thighs, elbows slightly soft. Very subtle breathing and balanced weight shift. No slouch, backward lean, crouching, looking down, turning or gestures.

jobs.name: Walk_Candidate
jobs.prompt: A confident relaxed young adult walks straight forward at a normal comfortable pace. Upright torso and neutral pelvis, open relaxed shoulders, eyes looking ahead. Compact natural steps with heel contact and toe push-off, soft knees and opposing relaxed bent arm swing. Both hands loosely closed. Continuous steady walking, no stopping, turning, swagger or slouch.

jobs.name: Run_Candidate
jobs.prompt: A healthy young adult runs straight forward at a steady athletic jogging pace. Compact quick running strides, clear foot push-off and natural flight, bent elbows swing opposite legs, hands loosely closed. Body inclines slightly forward from ankles, chest open and spine long, head level looking ahead. Continuous running, no turning, stopping, crouching or leaning backward.

jobs.name: Jump_Candidate
jobs.prompt: A healthy athletic young adult facing forward performs one vertical jump from a tall relaxed stance. Brief knee bend with hips back and arms swing behind, extend ankles knees and hips to take off, arms swing forward, knees soften naturally in flight, land on both feet with a soft knee bend, recover fully to upright standing. No travel, turn, back arch, squat hold or spin.
